title: Prayer to St. Thérèse (The Little Flower)
text:
O Little Thérèse of the Child Jesus,
please pick for me a rose
from the heavenly garden
and send it to me
as a message of love.

O Little Flower of Jesus,
ask God today to grant the favors
I now place with confidence
in your hands.
[Mention your request]

St. Thérèse, help me to always believe
as you did, in God's great love for me,
so that I might imitate your "little way"
each day.
Amen.

translation.latin:
O parva Teresia Pueri Iesu,
quaeso carpe mihi rosam
de caelesti horto
et mitte eam mihi
sicut nuntium amoris.

O parvum Florem Iesu,
roga Deum hodie ut concedat favores
quos nunc pono cum confidentia
in manibus tuis.

Sancta Teresia, adiuva me semper credere
sicut tu credidisti, in magno amore Dei erga me,
ut imitari possim tuam "parvam viam"
quotidie.
Amen.

attribution: Traditional Prayer to St. Thérèse of Lisieux
notes: St. Thérèse of Lisieux (1873-1897) is known as 'The Little Flower' and is beloved for her 'Little Way' of spiritual childhood - trusting completely in God's mercy and love. She promised to spend her heaven doing good on earth and to 'let fall a shower of roses.' She is the patron saint of missions, florists, and France.
